Criar a fine-grained personal access token for the sync repo.
1. Open GitHub > Configurações > Developer settings > Pessoaal access tokens > Fine-grained tokens.
2. Tap Generate new token and name it YATA sync.
3. Under Repository access, select only your YATA sync repo.
4. Under Repository permissions, set Contents to Read and write.
5. Generate the token, copy it, then paste it here.
